integrity: Analytic radial proof, sorted-volume integration and explicit angular integral; bundled reproducibility checks test finite cases and do not replace proofs. Priority relative to incompletely accessible older literature is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exact uniform sampling and integration measure on [-1,1]; unweighted empirical affine least squares; unmodified intermediate weights; exact arithmetic; no regularization, pruning or ill-conditioned-design rejection. The three-node exact positivity constant and tail prefactor do not extend automatically to other measures or polynomial degrees.
title: Heavy-tail and positivity laws for random affine least-squares quadrature
